title: Corvus corone - Carrion Crow XC24828
author: Sander Pieterse
changes: Carrion crow (Corvus corone) giving four loud 'kraa' caws in The Hague, Netherlands, a recording shared through Xeno-canto (XC24828). Trimmed to 1.88–4.85 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The default 70 Hz high-pass is kept because the recording has low rumble below 80 Hz (about −24 dB relative to the caws).
